verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaign performance in natural language. AI Decisioning separately uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel and timing per customer, so in-product AI insights and suggestions are first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what insights the built-in agent surfaces and how, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.
AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing for each customer, then measures what worked.
AID learns which message, channel, and timing perform best for each person.
